name: @mavis/mcoded
description: Skeleton of the resident mcoded daemon (wave Ф4 contract): unix-socket listener with launchd-style LISTEN_FDS adoption, the pi-rpc-semantics JSONL wire (prompt/steer/follow_up/events with version, cursor and request-id) over pluggable transports, the bounded event replay ring, crash-only checkpoint recovery and graceful drain shutdown. The live agent runtime plugs in through the RuntimeAdapter seam; this wave ships an echo stub.
